---
title: "qrough example"
format:
  qrough-revealjs:
    mainfont: Excalifont   # any installed font; qrough does not set fonts
    qrough:
      roughness: 2         # how sketchy the lines are (0 = straight)
      bowing: 1            # how much lines curve between end points
      stroke-width: 1.5    # outline width in px
      fill-style: solid    # hachure, solid, zigzag, cross-hatch, dots, dashed, zigzag-line
      hachure-gap: 6       # spacing between fill lines (4 x stroke-width)
      hachure-angle: -41   # angle of the fill lines, in degrees
      fill-weight: 0.75    # thickness of the fill lines (stroke-width / 2)
      seed: 42             # base seed; fixed so shapes don't jitter on redraw
      callouts: true       # patch callouts
---
